name: loupe
description: Keeps agent-written UI on its design system. An authoring skill that sets the rules before the first draft, a conformance engine that correlates JSX component bindings with the CSS styling them — across stylesheets, inline styles and CSS-in-JS — names the exact token that replaces a hardcoded value, and catches composites rebuilt across files, plus hooks that report drift at write time rather than at review time. Ships profiles for the WordPress Design System, Archer and the VIP Design System; a fourth is a directory, not a fork.

blocking.title: Block turns on findings
blocking.description: When on, error-severity findings stop the turn and hand the report back. When off, the gate reports only. A project with no loupe.config.json is always advisory unless this is on.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: auto, or any bundled preset (`loupe presets` lists them — wpds, wordpress-components, wordpress-block-theme, archer, vip, base-ui, generic). 'auto' infers the preset from the markers each preset declares. A project's own loupe.config.json always wins.

project_prefixes.title: Project class prefixes
project_prefixes.description: Comma-separated CSS class prefixes your projects own, e.g. 'vip-workflow-, wf-'. Leave empty to infer per project. Only these can be reported dead.

off.title: Silence the hook
off.description: When on, the hook checks nothing in any project, even one that opted in, and says only that it was skipped. To silence one project instead, put "env": { "LOUPE_OFF": "1" } in its .claude/settings.local.json. `loupe` typed by hand is unaffected.

max_attempts.title: Fix attempts before standing down
max_attempts.description: Re-checks per session before the gate lets the turn through.

max_findings.title: Findings shown per report
max_findings.description: Cap per report, sampled across rules.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Lets the hooks ask Jev (TypeSafe) the judgement questions. Kept in your system keychain. Hooks only: for /loupe-fix --judge and the terminal, also put TYPESAFE_API_KEY=... in ~/.config/loupe/.env. Leave empty to skip judging.
